metadata.payload: u64 fast-path control; production IndexingNotification(H512, Vec<Option<u32>>) for notifications_3; component microbenchmark, not end-to-end throughput
metadata.method: Two AB/BA process passes per scenario; per-process warmup; timed process CPU/RSS includes warmup. Single process at a time.
metadata.percentiles: p50 sample median; p95 nearest rank
metadata.published_harness_note: Published main.rs received rustfmt whitespace formatting after this run; measured source hash is recorded separately. Production snapshot bodies are unchanged.
